prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one opaque square 2-by-2 material atlas for native 3D crafting-component models in an owned nineteenth-century Argentine dark-fantasy game. These models include old tool and blade components; the image itself contains only flat raw metal surfaces, no objects.
Primary request: painterly realistic aged metals matching detailed period inventory art. Exactly four equal square quadrants meeting at the center, edge to edge, no gutters, outlines, labels or framing.
Top-left: dark cold forged iron, charcoal gunmetal base, numerous fine tiny hammer pits, subtle scratched mottling and sparse brown oxidation specks. Top-right: tempered satin steel, medium slate gray rather than white or mirror chrome, very fine directional abrasion, hairline scratches, a few restrained dark tarnish marks. Bottom-left: worn antique brass, muted ochre golden brown, small irregular dark oxidation freckles and subtle fine polishing scratches. Bottom-right: darker aged iron with fine crossgrain abrasion and subdued rust mottling, suitable for mounting sockets.
Each quadrant is a continuous, seamless-looking homogeneous material swatch, not a photograph of a plate with outer edges. Orthographic flat diffuse albedo illumination; no perspective, cast shadow, spotlight, giant bright gradient, embossed ornaments, rivets or symbols. Dense small-scale surface variation, crisp but restrained, useful on miniature volumetric game items. Avoid pristine flat plastic, white silver, large black patches, obvious stripes and repeating large motifs. No text, logos, borders, transparency or background. Original texture art.
